SUMMARY: This factory builds a broadleaf leaf mesh via geometry nodes: a subdivided plane is displaced by a procedural vein/midrib network, trimmed to a leaf silhouette (with jigsaw-margin cutting), rippled by a wave deformation, then shaded with a translucent leaf material. leaf_broadleaf.py is the entry point defining the geometry nodegroups, shader, genome sampling, and the LeafFactoryBroadleaf class; it imports the leaf shader from leaf_maple.py and the wave/move-to-origin nodegroups from leaf_v2.py. To achieve a skeletonised leaf (only the vein lace remains, thick pale near midrib, thinning at margin), the key levers are the vein-mask thresholds/densities, the tissue-deletion selection, and vein color.

EDITABLE (upper-level files — change these to alter the result):

FILE: assets/objects/leaves/leaf_broadleaf.py
  nodegroup_random_mask_vein: masks/gates the secondary vein network (Voronoi-based reticulation) that breaks veins into segments.
    knobs: VoronoiTexture Randomness(0.2 fixed) -> vein irregularity; add offset(0.35 fixed) -> mask threshold rounding; map_range_1 out(2:0.02,3:0.95) -> vein-vs-gap balance; map_range_2 clamp band(1:0.001,2:0.005) -> vein edge sharpness. To skeletonise: widen these so more area reads as "vein".
  nodegroup_nodegroup_vein_coord_001 / nodegroup_nodegroup_vein_coord: parametric coordinate for vein direction; FloatCurve "Vein Shape" control points set vein sweep/angle along leaf; map_range_1(4:1.9) -> vein angle multiplier scale.
    knobs: vein_curve_control_points (per-instance lists in nodegroup_nodegroup_leaf_gen) -> vein fan pattern; Vein Angle/Asymmetry passed in.
  nodegroup_nodegroup_shape_with_jigsaw: computes leaf silhouette + jigsaw margin; feeds the LESS_THAN(0.5) delete selection that removes non-leaf area.
    knobs: Jigsaw Scale(input,~30-70) -> margin serration frequency; Jigsaw Depth(input,0-0.6) -> serration depth; multiply(1:0.05 fixed) -> depth scaling; map_range_1 band(1:0.001,2:0.002) -> edge crispness. Editing the LESS_THAN threshold or replacing the shape mask with the vein mask is how you delete tissue between veins (skeletonisation).
  nodegroup_nodegroup_shape: overall leaf outline via FloatCurve.
    knobs: shape_curve_control_points(default 7-pt list) -> leaf width profile; Y clamp(-0.6..0.6 fixed) -> body length band.
  nodegroup_nodegroup_midrib: midrib rib and its thickness falloff.
    knobs: midrib_curve_control_points -> midrib centerline wobble; NoiseTexture Scale(20 fixed)+multiply(0.01) -> rib noise; map_range_2(Midrib Length/Width inputs) -> rib taper; map_range_4 band(1:0.001,2:0.03) -> rib width/pale core (raise upper for thicker pale midrib).
  nodegroup_nodegroup_apply_vein_midrib: combines main + two secondary vein coords and midrib into final vein value (the lace network); this is the central knob for skeletonisation.
    knobs: random_scale_seed(default 1.08, sampled via vein_mask_random_seed 0-100) & *2.7 factor -> secondary vein spacing; map_range Leaf-Shape gate(1:-0.3,2:0.05,3:0.015) -> vein thinning toward margin (thinner veins at edge); NoiseTexture Scale(20)+multiply(0.02) -> vein jitter; map_range_4(2:0.03) & map_range_5 band(1:0.001,2:0.01) -> main-vein thickness/threshold. Increase output coverage + delete tissue where vein value is low to leave only veins.
  nodegroup_nodegroup_sub_vein: fine tertiary reticulation micro-veins.
    knobs: VoronoiTexture Scale(30 fixed), second Voronoi Scale(150) -> micro-vein density; map_range(2:0.1) -> contrast.
  nodegroup_nodegroup_leaf_gen: assembles midrib/shape/three vein-coord sets, applies Z displacement (Displancement scale=0.005) and margin curl (multiply_2 *0.7); wires the delete-geometry step.
    knobs: three inline vein_curve_control_points/handles lists -> distinct vein tiers; SubdivideMesh Level not here (see geo). float_curve margin-curl points -> edge lift.
  shader_material: leaf surface shading; mixes base blade color, noise hue/value variation, and vein color by "vein value".
    knobs: NoiseTexture Scale(6.8),Detail(10),Roughness(0.7) -> mottling; map_range_1 hue band(3:0.48,4:0.52) & map_range_2 value band(3:0.8,4:1.2) -> color variation; hue_saturation_value_1 Value(2.0) -> shading brightness; mix uses kwargs["color_base"]/["color_vein"]. For pale veins set vein color high value/low saturation and raise vein mask so veins dominate.
  geo_leaf_broadleaf: top-level geo graph; sets SubdivideMesh Level(10) -> mesh resolution; Displancement scale(0.005 fixed); subvein displacement multiply(0.0002 fixed); Wave Scale X(0.2)/Y(1.0) fixed.
    knobs: subdivide Level(10) -> vein detail fidelity (raise for lace crispness); wave scales -> ripple.
  LeafFactoryBroadleaf: factory; scale=0.5; season-based HSV color sampling.
    knobs: scale(0.5) -> overall size; season autumn/summer/spring/winter -> blade/vein HSV ranges (autumn hue uniform 0.0-0.20 sat0.85 val0.9, vein val0.7); color_randomness(uniform 0.05-0.10) -> per-instance color jitter; per-channel normal noise (hue σ0.02, sat/val σ=color_randomness); obj.scale normal(1,0.1) jitter.
  LeafFactoryBroadleaf.sample_geo_genome: randomly sampled genome (all uniform).
    knobs: midrib_length(0.0-0.8), midrib_width(0.5-1.0), stem_length(0.7-0.9), vein_asymmetry(0.0-1.0), vein_angle(0.4-1.0), vein_density(3.0-8.0 -> more/tighter veins = finer lace), subvein_scale(10-20), jigsaw_scale(30-70), jigsaw_depth(0.0-0.6), vein_mask_random_seed(0-100); curve point lists for midrib/shape/vein.
  create_asset: adds y_wave/x_wave control points (y peak uniform 0.25-0.75/0.50-0.60; x_wave_val 0.50-0.58) -> leaf waviness; builds material color kwargs.

LINKED TO INFINIGEN (infra — do NOT edit, resolved from the original package):
  assets/objects/leaves/leaf_maple.py -> provides nodegroup_leaf_shader (translucent/glossy/diffuse leaf shader) imported by broadleaf; sibling maple factory (shown for reference, not the entry).
  assets/objects/leaves/leaf_v2.py -> provides nodegroup_apply_wave and nodegroup_move_to_origin used by broadleaf; sibling V2 factory.
  assets/__init__.py / assets/colors.py -> color palette helpers (plant_green/yellow/red, hsv2rgba).
  assets/utils/object.py -> mesh/object utility helpers.
  core/nodes/node_utils.py -> to_nodegroup decorator, assign_curve for FloatCurve control points.
  core/nodes/node_wrangler.py, node_info.py, utils.py, compatibility.py -> NodeWrangler + Nodes enum, node graph construction engine.
  core/surface.py -> add_geomod / add_material application of geometry+shader to object.
  core/placement/factory.py -> AssetFactory base class (seeding, asset spawn interface).
  core/placement/detail.py -> level-of-detail utilities.
  core/tagging.py, core/tags.py -> tag_object semantic tagging ("leaf_broadleaf").
  core/util/blender.py -> apply_transform and Blender helpers.
  core/util/color.py -> hsv2rgba color conversion.
  core/util/math.py -> FixedSeed deterministic sampling.
  core/util/random.py, logging.py -> RNG and logging helpers.
  core/__init__.py, core/nodes/__init__.py, core/placement/__init__.py, core/util/__init__.py -> package init/exports.
